_note: Machine settings: edit every /path/to/... below. Each model runs in its own Python environment (python) with its weights (weights); Blender and the Docker sandbox are for codification; env is exported to every model process (HF_HOME and TORCH_HOME hold the models SAM 3D loads by name: MoGe and DINOv2). The gpu fields are overridden by --gpus / --gpu.

budget.prices_note: gemini-3.8-flash Standard tier (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing), checked 2026-10-23; valid through 2026-12-31, doubles on 2027-01-01. Cached input (usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens) at $0.075.

proposals._note: class-agnostic SAM 3 proposals (the tracks model) on evenly spaced frames; the ones no track explains (no track mask covers the same region, each at least unexplained_overlap inside the other) are named by the vocabulary VLM ('none' = ground and what covers it, walls, sky, scenery, shadows) and tracked from their masks (groups of group_size objects, track_window frames around the seed, 0 = whole video); a proposal track repeating a track (the same region, or inside it under the same name, at dedupe_iou) is dropped

objects3d._note: SAM 3D Objects (facebook/sam-3d-objects) for the room meshes and make_objects; --gpu overrides gpu.
